title: The optogenetic tool ASAP acutely inhibits autophagy
snippet: Mondal et al. present an optogenetic tool to rapidly inhibit autophagy, named ASAP. Proteomic profiling with ASAP shows the most tightly regulated autophagy substrates, including nuclear pore complex proteins.
